item.title: 'If Peace Fails, We Have Other Means': Taliban Minister On Pak Conflict

item.title: Israel To Sit Out Gaza Peace Summit Hosted By Trump And Egypt's Sisi

item.title: Zelensky Warns Russia Of Exploiting Lack Of 'Attention' On War

item.title: 43 Years, Not Enough: At 92, World's Oldest Leader Could Rule Till He's 99

media:content.media:description: Cameroonian President Paul Biya casts his ballot as his wife Chantal watches.

item.description: Paul Biya, 92, the world's oldest president, seems ready to extend his 43-year rule as Cameroon heads to the polls. The single-phase election on Sunday is expected to give Biya a new seven-year term.

item.title: Shots Fired, Borders Shut: Heavy Clashes Between Pak, Afghanistan Forces
